title: Bad specification language
statement: For natural numbers $C$ and $c$ and a language $V$ of Boolean lists, define a language consisting of those Boolean lists $z$ for which the bad-specification predicate holds on the five inputs $g_x(z)$, $g_U(z)$, $g_u(z)$, $g_j(z)$, and $g_p(z)$.
caveat: The definitions of the predicate and of $g_x$ are not included, so the defining condition cannot be rendered more explicitly.
